title: Outstanding Oven Australian Rice Vermicelli Noodles
description: A funky and velvety Australian dish featuring rice vermicelli, dum, and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a light dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Cook the rice vermicelli noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped dum, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the pan and cook until the dum is lightly browned.
Add the sliced chicken breast to the pan and cook until it is browned and cooked through.
Add the cooked rice vermicelli noodles, soy sauce, and sesame oil to the pan and stir to combine.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes.
Remove the pan from the oven and serve the Outstanding Oven Australian Rice Vermicelli Noodles hot.
